description: This file is a controller class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, specifically implementing the Order API endpoints. It handles various order-related actions such as setting customer info, payment and shipping addresses, fetching cart details, adding products, confirming orders, and modifying order history. The class extends the core Controller class and interacts with models for extensions and orders. It acts as an API interface for order management functionalities within the Opencart system.
external_methods: exttt{	extbackslash Opencart	extbackslash System	extbackslash Engine	extbackslash Controller}

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Controller class providing API endpoints for managing orders in Opencart, including setting customer details, addresses, retrieving cart info, adding products, confirming orders, and managing order history.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for the API, routes actions based on 'call' parameter and returns JSON response.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Sets customer information via internal controller call.

methods.name: setPaymentAddress
methods.description: Sets payment address via internal controller call.

methods.name: setShippingAddress
methods.description: Sets shipping address, first checks cart state, then calls relevant controllers.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available shipping methods, requiring customer, cart, and address data.

methods.name: setShippingMethod
methods.description: Sets the chosen shipping method after verifying dependencies.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available payment methods based on current cart and address info.

methods.name: setPaymentMethod
methods.description: Sets the payment method after validation.

methods.name: extension
methods.description: Handles extension-related API actions, including retrieving extension data by code.

methods.name: setAffiliate
methods.description: Sets affiliate information via internal controller.

methods.name: getCart
methods.description: Fetches current cart details, including products, totals, and shipping requirements.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart, updates totals, and returns updated cart info.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms and creates an order, performing validations and storing order data.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a history comment/status update to an existing order.
